Class EntityManager

      Updates the table, which links the entity with the referred entities.
      Parameters:
      table - describes the link table, it contains a table name, the column name for the id, and for the referred entity id.
      entityId - the id of the entity, for which the links are created.
      referencedIds - the id of the referred entities.
